process DNAAPLER_ALL {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_low'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
?         'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/e7/e78ff2b68785061949b030afb1ff73db6a8d21d5d11c032236f1a1ef93477afa/data'
:         'community.wave.seqera.io/library/dnaapler:1.4.0--da1c8ba3b41e40c6' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(assembly), path(ignore)
    tuple val(meta2), path(custom_db)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_reoriented.fasta")                  , emit: fasta
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_reoriented.gfa")                    , emit: gfa    , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_all_reorientation_summary.tsv")     , emit: summary
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_MMseqs2_output.txt")                , emit: hits   , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.log")                               , emit: log
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('dnaapler'), eval("dnaapler --version | sed 's/.*version //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_dnaapler

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args          = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix            = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    // dnaapler only treats --ignore as a file if the value contains '/' or a '.'
    def ignore_arg    = ignore ? "--ignore ./${ignore}" : ''
    def custom_db_arg = custom_db ? "--custom_db ${custom_db}" : ''
    """
    dnaapler all \\
        --input ${assembly} \\
        --output ${prefix}_dnaapler \\
        --prefix ${prefix} \\
        --threads ${task.cpus} \\
        ${ignore_arg} \\
        ${custom_db_arg} \\
        ${args}

    mv ${prefix}_dnaapler/${prefix}_reoriented.fasta .
    mv ${prefix}_dnaapler/${prefix}_all_reorientation_summary.tsv .
    mv ${prefix}_dnaapler/dnaapler_*.log ${prefix}.log
    # Not produced for a GFA without circular contigs (no MMseqs2 search is run)
    if [ -f ${prefix}_dnaapler/${prefix}_MMseqs2_output.txt ]; then
        mv ${prefix}_dnaapler/${prefix}_MMseqs2_output.txt .
    fi
    if [ -f ${prefix}_dnaapler/${prefix}_reoriented.gfa ]; then
        mv ${prefix}_dnaapler/${prefix}_reoriented.gfa .
    fi
    """

    stub:
    def args     = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix       = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def is_gfa   = assembly.name ==~ /.*\.gfa(\.(gz|bz2|xz))?$/
    """
    echo "${args}"

    touch ${prefix}_reoriented.fasta
    ${is_gfa ? "touch ${prefix}_reoriented.gfa" : ''}
    touch ${prefix}_all_reorientation_summary.tsv
    touch ${prefix}_MMseqs2_output.txt
    touch ${prefix}.log
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/dnaapler/all"
description: "Reorients complete bacterial chromosomes, plasmids and phages to start\
  \ at a conserved gene"
keywords:
- "reorientation"
- "genome assembly"
- "chromosome"
- "plasmid"
- "phage"
- "dnaA"
- "fasta"
- "gfa"
tools:
- dnaapler:
    description: "Reorients complete microbial chromosomes, plasmids and phages to\
      \ begin with\na conserved start gene (e.g. dnaA, repA or terL) using MMseqs2\
      \ searches\nagainst a bundled protein database.\n"
    homepage: "https://github.com/gbouras13/dnaapler"
    documentation: "https://dnaapler.readthedocs.io"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/gbouras13/dnaapler"
    doi: "10.21105/joss.05968"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: ""
    args_id: "$args"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - assembly:
      type: "file"
      description: "Complete assembly in FASTA or GFA format, optionally compressed\n\
        with gzip, bzip2 or xz\n"
      pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,fna,gfa}{,.gz,.bz2,.xz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3975"
  - ignore:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional. Text file listing contig IDs (one per line) to leave\n\
        un-reoriented. Only the first whitespace-delimited token of each line is used.\n"
      pattern: "*"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing custom database information\ne.g. `[ id:'custom_db'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - custom_db:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional. Uncompressed amino acid FASTA file used as a custom\
        \ database\ninstead of the bundled one (passed with `--custom_db`).\n"
      pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,faa}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
output:
  fasta:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_reoriented.fasta:
        type: "file"
        description: "Reoriented assembly in FASTA format"
        pattern: "*_reoriented.fasta"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  gfa:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_reoriented.gfa:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Reoriented assembly graph, only emitted for GFA input"
        pattern: "*_reoriented.gfa"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3975"
  summary:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_all_reorientation_summary.tsv:
        type: "file"
        description: "Per-contig summary of the reorientation performed"
        pattern: "*_all_reorientation_summary.tsv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  hits:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_MMseqs2_output.txt:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Tabular MMseqs2 hits against the reorientation database.\n\
          Not emitted for a GFA input without circular contigs\n"
        pattern: "*_MMseqs2_output.txt"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  log:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}.log:
        type: "file"
        description: "dnaapler run log"
        pattern: "*.log"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
  versions_dnaapler:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - dnaapler:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - dnaapler --version | sed 's/.*version //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - dnaapler:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - dnaapler --version | sed 's/.*version //':
        type: "eval"
